incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INFERENCE_GATEWAY_5XX_HIGH — region=usw2, 1m 5xx rate ~8.1% (baseline 0.2%). PD: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/P12345 • Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.com/inference/502-spike
carol.oncall: I’m paged and on it. Any immediate customer reports? @alice.sre
dave.support: Support note: ACME Inc reported failing requests about 12:07 UTC — they see 502s on generate calls. Tkt #3421
alice.sre: looking at dashboards now — spike starts ~12:06 UTC, origin 502s from auth-proxy-usw2 -> downstream token-introspect returning 502s. traces: short timeout + 502 response body.
bob.eng: I pushed an auth-proxy tweak at 12:02 (small header parsing change). rolling back to v2.3.0 now: `./deploy rollback auth-proxy --to v2.3.0`
incident-bot: Deploy rollback initiated by bob.eng • Job: rollback-auth-proxy-7765 • See CI: https://ci.redwood.com/jobs/rollback-auth-proxy-7765
alice.sre: quick log snippet from auth-proxy: ```ERROR 12:06:11 token-introspect timeout -> upstream 502 from auth-service (connection reset)``` looks like token-introspect path failing under a specific header combo
bob.eng: rollback finished, healthchecks green. Confirming no new 502s on the canary shard.
alice.sre: metrics updating — 5xx rate dropping to 1.2% over last 3m, p95 latency returning to normal. Continuing to watch for 20m.
carol.oncall: marking mitigated for pager purposes. I’ll stay on until 12:40 UTC. Assigning postmortem owners: alice.sre, bob.eng. Please add RCA notes and timeline. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: Incident P12345 acknowledged by carol.oncall; escalation suppressed.
alice.sre: added incident notes and links: runbook, CI rollback, support ticket #3421, traces. Next: root cause analysis — investigate why auth-service returned 502 on introspect (connection pool / header edge case).
dave.support: Noted — will follow up with ACME on status and share postmortem link when available.
carol.oncall: thanks team. If error rate creeps up again, re-open PD and ping #eng-sre. Closing thread in Slack after verification. :v:
